PERSONAL DATA → EDEN PRODUCT WORKFLOW v2.0

PRIVATE PERSONAL RECORD → identify recurring task/problem → extract
generic capability requirement → remove identifying/private data → ARGOS
evidence/research → map existing EDEN capability/provider →
reuse/integrate if adequate → define App/Helper ownership → prototype in
personal Workspace → test with real private data locally → create
synthetic/de-identified test fixtures → verify → package reusable
capability → Family & Friends gate → broader edenOS/AppDev integration.

RULE: Personal data may validate a workflow but must not become the
distributable dataset.
